regime_context: China A-shares detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure (Banks vs Innovative Pharma & CXO, margin 0.01) with only 4/22 themes eligible and the absolute-trend gate flagged as did_NOT_hold_here for this market. Backtest verdict is discipline_not_prediction and cross-sectional rank-IC is weak, so this note leans low overall.
emerging_watch: Watch Semiconductors (512760.SS): eligible true, hurst_tag trend, and breadth 0.091. If its score climbs above ~0.5 and durability_bar improves toward 0.5 while breadth expands above 0.2, that would suggest a broadening leadership beyond the Banks/Pharma pair; if score decays below 0.2 over the next two weeks, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks lead the rank with the highest durability bar (0.73) and broadest eligible breadth (0.889), suggesting the leadership is cohesive rather than a thin single-name move. The crowding flag (z 1.78) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. Given the gate did not help on this market's history, I treat this as a conditional lean on continuation of the prevailing narrative, not a validated edge.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded and the detector's own backtest says the trend gate did not reduce drawdown on China A-shares, meaning the leadership can whip back quickly on a mean-reverting tape.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% or more before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the confirmed challenger (score 0.988) with a rotation margin to Banks of only 0.01, indicating a genuine two-theme contest rather than a dominant single narrative. Durability bar (0.60) is second-highest. Crowding is also elevated (z 1.59), so this is a capped continuation lean, not a new entry signal.
theses.dissent: Crowding z 1.59 plus a narrow rotation breadth (0.18 eligible) suggests the leadership pair could both stall; the detector has no validated edge for predicting which of the two wins.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ falls more than 8% relative to Banks (512800.SS) before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is one of only four eligible themes (score 0.495) but carries a mean-revert hurst_tag and middling durability_bar (0.46) with only 0.30 breadth. Given the gate did not help on this market and the hurst tag flags mean-reversion rather than trend continuation, I lean away from using this theme as a trend-following vehicle.
theses.dissent: It is eligible and in the top half by score; on a different regime the mean-revert tag could mean a contrarian bounce rather than continued weakness.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS gains more than 5% while Banks (512800.SS) lags the CSI 300 over the check window
